<p class="page-deck">Andrew Sudmant leads the development of the Cities & Climate Learning Lab within Simon Fraser University's School of Resource and Environmental Management.</p>

## Research focus

Andrew is an Assistant Professor in Simon Fraser University's School of Resource and Environmental Management. His research examines climate-compatible urban development, the governance and delivery of climate action, co-benefits and the evidence available to decision-makers. He is a Lead Author for Chapter 5 of the IPCC Special Report on Climate Change and Cities.

## Approach

His work combines climate-policy and economic modelling, public-policy appraisal and decision-support tools with attention to the institutions through which local climate action is delivered. Before joining SFU, he worked at the Edinburgh Climate Change Institute. He is a Lead Author for Chapter 5, “Solutions by City Types and Regions,” of the IPCC Special Report on Climate Change and Cities.

## Education

- BA (Honours), Economics, University of British Columbia
- MSc, Environmental Policy and Regulation, London School of Economics and Political Science
- PhD, Sustainability Research Institute, School of Earth and Environment, University of Leeds
